biggest_catch: The offer EXPIRES September 30, 2026 — and it is not for everyone: you must open a youth savings account for a minor under age 18 (with you as joint owner) within 30 days of the new checking account — impossible if you have no qualifying minor — and the checking account must complete 20 qualifying transactions or receive $500 in qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days.
catches: OFFER EXPIRES September 30, 2026 — expiring within 14 days; both promotional accounts must be opened during the promotional period, within 30 days of each other, and the youth savings account requires a minor under age 18 with the checking account owner as joint owner.
For individuals who do not currently own a KTCCU checking account; accounts that are closed and reopened do not qualify.

To qualify, the checking account must complete at least 20 qualifying transactions OR receive at least $500 in total qualifying direct deposits that post within the first 90 days after the checking account is opened.

Qualifying direct deposits include electronic ACH deposits of payroll, pension, Social Security, or other government benefits only — transfers between accounts, mobile/remote check deposits, P2P payments, and other non-payroll ACH credits do not qualify.
Both promotional accounts must be enrolled in eStatements and remain in good standing for at least 90 days after the second qualifying account is opened and until incentives are paid.
KTCCU may disregard transaction activity it determines is repetitive, artificial, or abusive rather than normal account use.
Limit one adult bonus, one youth bonus, and one school donation per qualifying checking account and youth savings account pair; the $50 school donation goes to the school, not to you.
Incentives are paid within 45 days after eligibility requirements are met and verified; bonuses may be reported as interest income for tax purposes.
KTCCU reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate this promotion at any time.

steps: During the promotional period (through September 30, 2026), open a new KTCCU checking account (minimum opening deposit $25); if you are a new member, also open a primary savings account ($5 minimum) to establish membership.
Within 30 days of opening the checking account, open a new KTCCU youth savings account (minimum opening deposit $5) for a minor under age 18, with you (the checking account owner) as joint owner.
Enroll both promotional accounts in eStatements.

Within the first 90 days after the checking account is opened, complete at least 20 qualifying transactions (posted deposits, withdrawals, transfers, debit purchases, checks, electronic payments) OR receive at least $500 in total qualifying direct deposits (ACH payroll, pension, Social Security, or government benefits only).

Keep all KTCCU accounts open, not overdrawn or restricted, and in good standing for at least 90 days after the second qualifying account is opened; the $100 adult bonus and $50 youth bonus are paid within 45 days after eligibility requirements are met and verified.
timing: Incentives will be paid within 45 days after eligibility requirements have been met and verified. Both promotional accounts must remain in good standing for at least 90 days after the second qualifying account is opened and until incentives are paid.
